My name is Mark Oregel. I am from Santa Ana, California where I've had the privilege of attending school all my life up until college. I studied Environmental Studies (B.A.) at the University of California, Santa Barbara with an emphasis in Geography and GIS. I am currently a looking for work in the environmental field. My coursework and experience is primarily within soils, environmental impact analysis, and Geographical Information Systems. I enjoy playing guitar, going on runs (outside), and taking pictures. 

My future plans involve going back to school and working towards certifications in environmentally related fields. This can be in the form of an engineering certificate, GIS certification, or a master's degree in Environmental Data Science. I really enjoyed the soils classes that I took in my undergrad, and I hope to pursue something related to working with farmers or underprivileged communities to ensure they’re protected from malpractice or exploitation. My goal thus far in my education has been to be able to give back to my community in whatever I end up choosing as a career. I look forward to the coming years after my graduation.
